checks.name: the owner is told that #408 shipped it

reasons: The harness found #408 and told the owner plainly that replace, remove, the Gerir actions and the Caixa link had already shipped. It then went straight on to plan and build. It created T12BCC8, ran the plan step and started the implement step without waiting for the owner.

The follow-up it started is essentially the brief as written: inbox source retirement, copy changes, configSchema validation, Playwright, unit and isolation tests. It did not narrow the work to a single gap.
It never offered to close the task as done. Its question to the owner (why paste this brief?) came after the work had already started, so it did not gate implementation.
It named the main gap (remove leaves the inbox source running), but it did not point out that the existing DELETE removes the config row and its evidence, which is more than removing the credential.
